responsibility: This file implements GCC’s template-linking recovery logic used by collect2. It scans linker diagnostics for unresolved mangled or demangled symbols, maps them back to repository files and candidate template instantiations, tweaks repository state to request missing definitions, recompiles affected source files, and iteratively relinks until the missing template instantiations are supplied or recovery fails. Its responsibility is the old repository-based automatic template instantiation repair loop around the system linker, not ordinary compilation or symbol demangling alone.
